findings.description: Previous fix #7 NOT fixed (all 4 images): GitHub activity RECENT ACTIVITY still shows identical duplicate PR rows without event verbs ('herdr-t3 · PR #157' twice at Nov 24, 16:37 JST; 'tastile-root · PR #159' twice at Nov 24, 16:36 JST; 'ty-plus · PR #572' also has no verb).
Previous fix #6 NOT fixed (all 4 images): /now DISCORD panel still displays mid-word truncation 'presence data stale or unavail...' despite spare horizontal room inside the panel.

Mobile /now legibility & scale mismatch (02-mob-light.png, 03-mob-dark.png): While GitHub activity now swaps cleanly to the 560px stacked mobile SVG, /now still renders the 800x512 desktop SVG at ~0.45x, leaving timestamps, presence detail, 'declared · rebuildup.dev', and stat-cell labels/units unreadably small (~5-6px) and visually mismatched against the larger GitHub activity card below it.

Previous fix #3 partially fixed (00-desk-light.png, 01-desk-dark.png): The private-repo summary no longer crosses the inner panel border, but still mid-word truncates on desktop as '8 private repos · 1,490 commits · 548 PRs (aggre...' (fits completely on mobile as '(aggregated)').

Previous fix #8 partially fixed (00-desk-light.png, 01-desk-dark.png): Desktop RECENT ACTIVITY rows 4 and 7 still truncate right after a middot as 'tastile-root · Issue #158 ·...' instead of fitting 'closed' (fits completely on mobile).

Mobile stacked GitHub activity footer crowding (02-mob-light.png, 03-mob-dark.png): The footer 'observed Nov 24, 2026 · 16:41 JST · rebuildup.dev' sits almost flush against the bottom card border (~2px gap), breaking the card's outer padding rhythm.

Mobile stacked GitHub activity zero-event rows (02-mob-light.png, 03-mob-dark.png): EVENTS BY REPOSITORY lists 10 repos including 4 zero-event rows ('atcoder-kit', 'FlashBeat', 'key-map-kanata', 'pc-setup' at '0 ev' with empty bars), unnecessarily inflating mobile card height compared to desktop's 6 active repos.

Minor SVG consistency details (all 4 images): Card header style differs between 'NOW · @rebuildup' (all caps with handle) and 'GitHub activity' (sentence case, no handle, repeating the markdown heading above it); desktop EVENTS BY REPOSITORY bars start flush under the repo icon with tighter vertical pitch whereas mobile bars indent cleanly under the repo name with generous pitch.

Verified fixed from previous review: #1 /now stat-cell labels fit cleanly inside borders; #2 DECLARED FOCUS header-to-bullet gap is clean; #4 /activity left inner panel aligns flush with header and footer; #5 repo-row bars no longer collide with next row's icon; #9 mobile GitHub activity renders the stacked single-column <picture> variant with legible text; #10 1px panelStroke borders cleanly define dark SVGs on dark mode. Known limitations observed (non-blocking): sharp corners on Selected work WebP, orphan p5* icon in mobile Stack Languages.

verdict.summary: Overall verdict: ACCEPT WITH FIXES. Strong visual progress across all 4 renders: 6 of 10 previous findings are cleanly resolved (stat-cell label fit, DECLARED FOCUS gap, /activity left-margin alignment, repo-row pitch, stacked mobile GitHub activity <picture> swap, and 1px panelStroke borders on dark mode). Requirements: Information hierarchy=MET, Status intuitiveness=MET, Consistency=PARTIAL, Mobile=PARTIAL, Light/dark=MET, Composition=PARTIAL. Top 3 fixes by impact: (1) Fix remaining SVG copy/feed regressions — add PR event verbs to eliminate duplicate RECENT ACTIVITY rows, remove mid-word truncations ('unavail...', '(aggre...'), and fix desktop 'Issue #158 ·...' truncation; (2) Add a stacked mobile <picture> variant for /now so secondary labels/timestamps match the legibility and scale of the mobile GitHub activity card; (3) Increase bottom padding under the mobile GitHub activity footer and suppress '0 ev' rows to tighten mobile height.
